notes.title: 0.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[h2]English Translation[/h2][p]Hello, this is Habom Studio.[/p][p]We have addressed several bugs and added voice acting to the characters.
Please refer to the update notes below for further details.[/p][p][b]Update Notes[/b][/p][p]\[Production][/p][list][*][p]Character voice dubbing has been added, allowing for a richer and more immersive gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Some awkward lines have been revised for improved dialogue flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain production issues have been corrected.[/p][/*][/list][p]\[Bug Fixes][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where BGM would not play correctly when moving to specific sections via the backlog in some scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]We have identified an issue where auto-progress operates abnormally slow and will be addressing it in an upcoming update.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.0.2 Update + ENG & JP Localization added!
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is Habom Studio.[/p][p]The demo build was updated around 03:57 AM (KST).[/p][p][/p][p]Please note that the default language is set to English.  [/p][p]You can change it in the Settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]\[Language]  [/h3][p]Localization for [b]English[/b] and [b]Japanese[/b] have been added.[/p][p][/p][h3]\[Scenario]  [/h3][p]The previous story structure (Prologue → Sae-un → Ji-hye → Yun-ha)  [/p][p]has been changed as follows:  [/p][p]After the prologue, you can choose a character route:  [/p][p]Ji-hye Route - 3 chapters  [/p][p]Yun-ha Route - 3 chapters  [/p][p]Sae-un Route - 3 chapters[/p][p][/p][h3]\[Visuals & Storytelling]  [/h3][p]Some mismatched background assets have been fixed.  [/p][p]Time and location cues were adjusted to match the new languages.[/p][p][/p][h3]\[Illustrations]  [/h3][p]1 ECG has been added per playable character in their main scenario.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Programming]  [/p][p]Support for Linux has been discontinued.[/p]
